page_title: TOR 0-0 FIO | Torino v Fiorentina 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Matteo Marchetti has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Ivan Juric, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90' Vincenzo Italiano isn't happy on the touchline after referee Matteo Marchetti shows him a yellow card.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Saba Sazonov (Torino) comes onto the pitch so that Karol Linetty can be given a rest.
85' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) replacing Giacomo Bonaventura.
84' A substitution has been made. Duvan Zapata goes off and Pietro Pellegri (Torino) comes on.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
77' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Vanja Milinkovic-Savic.

72' Duvan Zapata (Torino) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
72' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
71' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
68' Substitution. Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) on for Riccardo Sottil.

64' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a fantastic save! Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the left post, but the effort is kept out.

63' Fiorentina slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
60' That's unlucky! Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
57' Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there.
56' Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Torino win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
54' Here is a change. Luca Ranieri is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina).

54' Nikola Milenkovic (Fiorentina) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Matteo Marchetti with no other option than to blow for a foul.
53' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
52' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Pietro Terracciano has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
49' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
47' Fiorentina can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

47' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina win a corner kick.
46' Ivan Juric makes a half-time substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) comes on in place of Antonio Sanabria.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) comes off for Antonin Barak.
46' Vincenzo Italiano makes a switch. Maxime Lopez is coming on in place of Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+10' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+7' Yet another yellow card and Samuele Ricci (Torino) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Matteo Marchetti doesn't allow any discussions.
45+7' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) picks up a yellow card.
45+6' Ivan Juric (Torino) gets a yellow card, off the field.
45+5' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Samuele Ricci (Torino), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
45+2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fiorentina.
45+2' Fiorentina have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
41' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is the one who receives a yellow card.
41' Celebrations are cut short for Torino as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review due to a foul in the build-up play.
41' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Torino players aren’t happy.

39' Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Duvan Zapata (Torino) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top left corner of the net.
35' Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
34' Corner kick. Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is ready to send the ball into the box.

34' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
32' The ball is cleared after Antonio Sanabria (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
30' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Torino will have a throw-in.
29' Karol Linetty (Torino) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Matteo Marchetti no option but to blow his whistle.
26' A lofted cross from Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.

25' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning.
24' Fiorentina are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' That was close by Antonio Sanabria (Torino)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
20' The corner from Samuele Ricci (Torino) is cleared away by the defence.
20' Samuele Ricci (Torino) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat. Torino have a corner.

19' The ball is laid off to Nikola Vlasic (Torino) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Pietro Terracciano to make a decent save. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
18' Close! Duvan Zapata (Torino) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
13' Adam Masina (Torino) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
12' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) tries to find Raoul Bellanova, but he puts too much power on the pass. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Fiorentina.
10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Karol Linetty (Torino), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
9' Ivan Juric is forced to make a change. Ivan Ilic is unable to continue due to injury, Samuele Ricci (Torino) comes on.
8' Looks like Ivan Ilic (Torino) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
7' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is booked by the referee.
5' What a miskick by Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fiorentina comes to nothing.
5' Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
4' Fiorentina are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' The game is interrupted now, Arthur Melo (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Torino will kick-off.
The players are out at last! Torino will take the kick-off.
Matteo Marchetti got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
